aggregate_export: All 48 diagnostic summary groups; exact Python float serialization; no patient or specimen records.

diagnostic_metadata.weighting: observed entries within replicate; equal replicates; repeated folds within specimen; equal specimens within patient; equal patients
diagnostic_metadata.centering: within each observed replicate/gene before aggregation
diagnostic_metadata.baseline_shift: inner and deployment errors compared on identical training observations; deployment training errors are in-sample; no causal attribution
diagnostic_metadata.interpretation: selected-model failure diagnosis on exposed development data; no retraining, altered predictor, or independent confirmation

historical_audit.verification_scope: Historical completed reconstruction of saved arrays; publishing this receipt does not repeat that audit.

reconstruction_procedure.adaptation: Formatting, explicit input/output paths, runtime environment check, and aggregate-only verification; original arithmetic functions unchanged.
reconstruction_procedure.full_reconstruction_requires: Original study bundles, prepared inputs, target arrays, and full diagnostic tables at receipt-bound locations. These are not included in this aggregate publication.
